verdict.rationale: Claude Design's own handoff bundle and the /design command in Claude Code give a coding agent packaged design context to implement. A community user calls the handoff skill solid. However, nothing shows an MCP server or a public API: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the bundle's contents (frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings) are not described. Missing for 10: a documented MCP server or API endpoint for agents, explicit exposure of frames, variables, screenshots and component mappings, and access for third-party agents beyond Claude Code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can pull real design context — frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings — through an MCP server or API to implement the design

citations.quote: When a design is ready to build, Claude packages everything into a handoff bundle that you can pass to Claude Code with a single instruction.
work directly in Claude Code with /design
The handoff skill in Claude Design is pretty solid.
